subject: Renewal orchestration launch and calendar anchors
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha@vitalworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal orchestration launch and calendar anchors

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the chat yesterday. Per our conversation, I want to kick off the formal renewal orchestration so we can lock terms, confirm the capacity uplift, and schedule the QBR. High-level agenda below:

- Confirm term change: move to 12M committed with seasonal burst (start date 2026-01-01)
- Capacity uplift ask: +20% reserved GPU throughput (expected targeted date 2026-02-01)
- Pricing and amortization options (staircase vs. flat uplift)
- Ops/staffing sprint to validate readiness and migration windows
- QBR scheduling (two provisional 90-min slots attached)

I attached a short mutual action plan (vitalworks-mop-2025.pdf) and an .ics with two proposed QBR anchors (qbr-slot-options.ics). Can you confirm: 1) which QBR slot works for your execs (option A: 2025-10-20 14:00 PT / option B: 2025-10-27 10:00 PT), and 2) whether the +20% uplift aligns with your forecast?

Next steps I propose once we have a slot: internal ops runbook and an intake call with Karthik from infra (cc'ed by me after we confirm), then a short pricing confirmation from Ben. Marissa will own exec readiness and QBR agenda.

Thanks — happy to adjust the timeline if you need more runway.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Renewal orchestration launch and calendar anchors

Olga —

Thanks, this looks good and succinct. Quick answers:

- QBR: Option B (2025-10-27 10:00 PT) works best for our CTO and head of ops.
- Capacity uplift: +20% aligns with our forecast for H1 2026 but we need a cost estimate that shows monthly amortization vs one-time uplift. Can Ben provide both views?

Two operational questions before we lock the MAP: 1) Will any migration downtime be required when we apply reserved capacity changes? 2) Do you support a staggered activation window (e.g., 50% on 2026-02-01, remaining 50% on 2026-03-01)?

I can put together a short list of stakeholders for the QBR and share a calendar invite once you confirm.

Appreciate it,
Samantha
VP Product, VitalWorks
samantha@vitalworks.com

Samantha / Olga —

Thanks for confirming the slot preference. Quick technical/ops notes:

- Migration downtime: none required for the reserved capacity change itself; allocation is handled by the routing layer and can be staged. We'll still run a short validation window (~30–60 mins) post-activation to confirm latency and cache warm-up.
- Staggered activation: fully supported. We recommend a 2-week monitoring window after each tranche; example plan: 50% activation 2026-02-01, validate through 2026-02-14, final 50% activation 2026-03-01.

Pricing note: I will produce both monthly amortized and upfront uplift views by EOD 10/06 and link the HubSpot deal (see below). For the MAP and runbook I drafted an ops intake checklist and a short readiness sprint outline — uploading to the shared Drive now.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DW-78921
Drive folder (ops runbook + MAP): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C_vitalworks-renewal

Summary and next steps (agreed):
- QBR confirmed: 2025-10-27 10:00 PT (90 minutes) — Marissa will follow up with the draft agenda and exec readouts.
- Capacity uplift: +20% reserved GPU (staggered activation accepted: 50% on 2026-02-01, final 50% on 2026-03-01).
- Ben to send pricing scenarios (monthly amortized and upfront) by EOD 2025-10-06 (Ben: noted).
- Ops sprint: intake call with Ben + Karthik (infra) week of 2025-10-13; we'll capture runbook steps in Drive.
- Sign-off: I'll send a short mutual action plan and DocuSign link for the committed term option once pricing is accepted.

Links referenced above are in the Drive folder; DocuSign draft will be shared 10/07. Samantha — once Ben posts the pricing, please confirm the amortization preference and I will circulate the DocuSign.

Thanks all — looking forward to the QBR prep.
